|game_text='''0 side — Hidden Base'''

Deploy Rendezvous Point. Place a planet system (with a parsec number from 1 to 8) from outside your deck face down on your side of table (not in play); that card indicates the planet where your "Hidden Base" is located. {While} this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at systems and sectors. {Flip} this card any time after you have deployed five battleground systems and your "Hidden Base" system.

'''7 side — Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers'''

{While} this side up, to draw a card from Force Pile, opponent must first use 1 Force. For each battleground system you control, you may cancel one opponent's Force drain (limit twice per turn). You may not deploy any systems. At each system opponent occupies during any deploy phase, opponent may 'probe' there by placing one card from hand face down beneath that system. {Place} out of play if "Hidden Base" system is 'probed;' Dark Side places 'probe' cards in Used Pile (and may retrieve 1 Force for each Probe Droid used to 'probe').
|printings={{Card versions/Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (Special Edition)}}
|notes=* Players Committee card image marked “D-E1” in the lower border, added to the [[Holotable]] image set on 27 January 2024.<ref name="ht-de1" /> It is the PC's current image of Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers.
* Same words as [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].
* Each Players Committee version has an image of each side: the 0 side (Hidden Base, main image) and the 7 side (Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, second image). “What changed on the image” shows the 0 side.
|rulings=* If the [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Hidden Base]] is a battleground system, it counts towards the 5 battleground systems needed to flip.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json complete card data], entry <code>7_136</code>, <code>rulings</code> field. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026181118id_/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* The [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Hidden Base]] marker from outside the deck matches the system on table if they have the same card title (even if they are from different sets).
* Systems deployed by Light count towards flipping even if subsequently converted or blown away.
* Flipping this Objective is an optional top-level action. If the conditions are met, Light may choose to flip whenever they are entitled to a top-level action, even during the weapons segment of a battle.
* (7-side) All blown away systems are considered to have been probed (even systems blown away earlier in the game).
* (7-side) If Dark has 1 card in Force Pile, they can pay 1 to draw and then fail to draw from the now-empty pile.

A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (27 January 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:SE-L-hiddenbase-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (18 August 2019): Same words as the previous version. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
